g.text: Four-phase development comparison · n = 1 per method
Points are single development trials; no between-trial uncertainty is estimable.
Signed forgetting averages three switches; positive values indicate loss. Transfer includes recurring tasks.
Cumulative performance uses the pinned integration grid and division by nominal steps × 500.
